mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a rising demand for goods and services, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an easing monetary cycle, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in payroll employment and a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong labor market growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a rising supply of goods and services, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts signals a decline in demand for housing, leading to lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in the consumer price index signals an easing monetary cycle with rising inflation expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of easing monetary policy with rising inflation expectations (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 10% signals a weak labor market, leading to lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in GDP growth rate and a decrease in the federal funds rate signals a strong demand for goods and services with easing monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth with easing monetary policy (t-test p > 0.05).
